create_incremental_pca: create an IncrementalPCA transformer with n_components and batch_size for memory-efficient dimensionality reduction
fit_incremental_pca: fit IncrementalPCA on large datasets using minibatches to compute principal components with constant memory
partial_fit_incremental_pca: incrementally fit IncrementalPCA on streaming data batches without loading all data into memory
transform_incremental_pca: transform new data onto the learned principal components for dimensionality reduction
fit_transform_incremental_pca: fit and transform data in one step using IncrementalPCA with minibatch processing
